18 New Delhi hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for New Delhi hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 New Delhi hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Vio.com at 3, TravelUp at 2, 6E Hotels at 1, Bag2Bag Hotels and Homes at 1, Booking.com at 1 and Radissonhotels.com at 1. These are the New Delhi rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 12 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at New Delhi hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($33 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 6% at Hotel Golden Oasis Delhi to 19% at The Park. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
